name: dress-l8-zoo-corner
note: Opus visual QA #34 (verbatim): "L8 drive-out ... flat dark plane". L8 south-east corner of the zoo wall with the town beyond: service road ring, kerbs, lamps and parked cars outside the wall. Look for: lit road and lamp light beyond the wall, no bare dark plane, nothing floating or sunk, wall and piers intact.
